title: kyllinga nervosa var. ruwenzoriensis
intro: Kyllinga nervosa var. ruwenzoriensis, commonly known as Ruwenzori Kyllinga or African Spear Grass, is a type of grass-like plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional African medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Kyllinga nervosa var. ruwenzoriensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antihelmintic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and eliminate parasitic worms. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
